title: crumbkit/skill-draft/v1
description: Each generated section of a tool's skill file, and what the draft did to it.

cut.description: Present when the output budget cut the result short, so data holds only its first rows.

budget.description: The most bytes that the run printed on standard output.

data.description: The rows of the page, up to the limit.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

next.description: The next steps, in the order the text prints them. It is absent when there are none.

commands.description: The commands that carry out the step, in order.

call.description: A command line of this tool.

run.description: A command line of another program.

text.description: The sentence or phrase that the text prints for the step.

total.description: The number of rows that matched, of which data holds one page. It is absent when the tool did not count the rows.

truncated.description: True when the document leaves out rows that matched, because of the limit or the output budget, and false when data holds every row.

Drafted.description: One generated section of the skill file and what the draft did to it.

section.description: The section's name: description, jobs or usage.

status.description: What the draft did: written, unchanged, would-change under --check, kept without usage, or unmarked when the file has no markers for the section.

Section.description: One generated section of a skill file.

oneOf.description: The frontmatter's `description`, from the root's about text.
The job table, from the goal headings of the tool's help.
The most-used commands, from exported usage.

Status.description: What the draft did to one section.

oneOf.description: `--check` found that a rerun without it would change the section.
The draft wrote new text into the section.
The section already held the text that the draft would write.
The draft had no usage to rank, so the section keeps its text.
The file has no markers for the section, so the draft leaves it out.

Summary.description: The figures of one draft: the file, the tool and the usage it read.

check.description: Whether the draft only checked the file, under --check, and wrote nothing.

file.description: The path of the skill file.

ignored.description: The runs that the ranking ignored, because they name another tool or a command that the tool no longer has.

runs.description: The runs of the tool that the usage directory holds, each span id once.

tool.description: The name that the tool's root command runs as.

unreadable.description: The non-empty lines of the usage files that are not an exported usage record.

usage.description: The usage directory that --usage named, or null without --usage.
